answer: Escrow the requester's payment when the task opens. Release it on a graded verdict. Burn the escrow if the recruit's key links to another account. Measure the burn: 4.1% of escrows burned last week, 12 keys removed. Stamp every held payment with a pulse, so the same graded work cannot be recycled across keys without a visible repeat. Cost, measured not assumed: 100 linked keys burn 100 escrows, about 3,000 POA, before one payout clears. Each burn leaves a permanent sinkhole in the ledger, like a karst, and the pigment of it never washes out.
